name: Equipment Sales Co Inc.
old_description: Founded in 1989, Equipment Sales Co Inc. represents the automotive service equipment manufacturers to entire Pacific Northwest Region. We offer sales, service, and installation of automotive service equipment, in addition to design, installation, training, and inspection services.
about:
Equipment Sales Co Inc. is based in Snohomish, Washington. Founded in 1989 by Scott Wilson, the company was incorporated to represent manufacturers of motor vehicle service equipment across the Pacific Northwest. In 1994, Kirby McFarland acquired the business and expanded it into a full distributor and contractor for automotive service equipment.

The company sells, installs, and services a range of automotive shop equipment including vehicle lifts (5,500 to 120,000 lb capacity), lubrication dispensing and inventory systems, compressed air systems, vehicle exhaust removal systems, and wheel service equipment. They also provide shop design, installation, training, and inspection services. Their technicians hold ALI certification for lift inspections.

They serve automotive dealerships, independent repair shops, municipal garages, and military maintenance facilities throughout the Pacific Northwest. Customers include car and truck dealers, independent shops, and municipal garages that use vehicle lifts.

The company distinguishes itself through factory-trained personnel and ALI-certified lift inspectors, offering warranty work for partner manufacturers such as Rotary Lift, Graco, and Champion.

name: Era Wire Inc
old_description: WIRE STRAIGHTENING AND CUTTING, PARTS AND TOOLING, AND WIRE MACHINERY SALES SINCE 1988
about:
Era Wire Inc. was founded in 1988 by Richard T. Rae in West Haven, Connecticut, initially operating as a wire straightening and cutting service and a dealer of used wire machinery. The family-owned business relocated to its current facility at 19– in West Haven in 1995 following continued growth. After Rae’s passing in 2015, his son Rich Jr. assumed leadership, adding an on-site distribution warehouse and through-feed centerless grinding to create a one-stop shop for ferrous and non-ferrous wire needs.

The company specializes in precision wire straightening and cutting for round, flat, and shaped materials across all tempers and alloys, complemented by heat treating, torsion straightening, and wire forming. Its through-feed centerless grinding service provides an alternative to turning and milling for components requiring tight diameter and surface-finish tolerances. The Quick Wire Program stocks pre-cut 304 spring-tempered stainless steel (including 304V and 316LVM), aluminum, copper, titanium, and high/low carbon steels, offering same-day shipping on stocked items.

Primary markets include the medical device industry, where ERA Wire supplies precision-straightened Bright Diamond Drawn wire for Swiss screw machining, and broader industrial sectors requiring ferrous and non-ferrous wire processing. Customers range from medical OEMs to job shops needing reliable, close-tolerance wire products.

Founded on a “customer first” philosophy summarized by the tagline “We give it to you straight,” ERA Wire maintains ISO 9001:2015 certification (since 2004) and adheres to RoHS III, REACH Annex XVII, California Proposition 65, and conflict-minerals (3TG) regulations, ensuring traceable quality and regulatory compliance for every shipment.

name: Erhardt Woodworks
old_description: Erhardt Woodworks specializes in custom cabinets, painted cabinets, MDF doors, epoxy resin tables, and live-edge furniture. Every piece is handcrafted in our Bismarck, North Dakota workshop and tailored to fit your home, business, or remodeling project. Whether you need a single live-edge table or a full kitchen cabinet installation, our team handles the entire process, from design to installation.
about:
Erhardt Woodworks operates a woodworking workshop in Bismarck, North Dakota, serving residential and commercial clients across Burleigh and Morton Counties. The company handcrafts every piece in its Bismarck facility and tailors each project to the client's home, business, or remodeling needs.

The shop produces custom European-style cabinets, painted cabinets, MDF doors and drawer fronts, Baltic birch dovetail drawer boxes, epoxy resin tables, live-edge furniture, and live-edge countertops. Its capabilities cover design, fabrication, finishing, delivery, and installation. Materials include solid hardwoods, MDF, high-quality veneers, Baltic birch, and premium epoxy resin systems formulated to resist yellowing, heat, and moisture. Typical turnaround ranges from four to six weeks for smaller builds such as vanity cabinets, and eight to twelve weeks for full kitchen projects.

Erhardt Woodworks serves homeowners, general contractors, and business owners in Bismarck, Mandan, Lincoln, and surrounding communities, with select work extending across North Dakota. Projects range from single live-edge tables and accent cabinets to complete kitchen renovations and commercial fit-outs.

The company differentiates itself through color- and profile-matching services that replicate existing door styles using MDF or solid wood, a showroom where clients can examine finishes in person, and a commitment to managing each project from initial design through final installation.

name: Ernest Packaging Solutions
old_description: As a trusted food packaging company, we’ve earned a strong reputation as experts in the design, manufacturing and distribution of high-quality food packaging solutions. Our team specializes in creating innovative, sustainable packaging that preserves food quality, enhances shelf life and meets industry regulations.
about:
Ernest Packaging Solutions operates a full-service packaging facility in Nampa, Idaho, serving the greater Boise metro area and beyond. The company is a nationally operated business with a local touch, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. The Boise location functions as a regional hub for design, manufacturing, and distribution of packaging solutions across multiple industries.

The company designs, manufactures, and distributes a wide range of packaging products, including custom food, beverage, pharmaceutical, medical, cosmetics, retail, display, and industrial packaging. It also offers branded packaging, sustainable options using plant-based plastics and moisture-resistant coatings, and temperature-controlled solutions for cold-chain logistics. Beyond packaging products, Ernest provides packaging equipment integration—such as conveyor systems, case sealers, and complete line automation—as well as packaging supply management with just-in-time inventory and bulk ordering, plus facility supplies like safety gear and janitorial products.

Ernest serves customers in food and beverage, pharmaceutical, medical device, healthcare, cosmetics, retail, and industrial sectors. Named clients include The Rag Company, Sol-ti, Pizza Port Brewing Company, and No Toil, referencing needs from global shipping to sustainable temperature-controlled containers and high-volume order fulfillment.

The company emphasizes its nationally operated scale combined with local responsiveness, creative problem-solving, and sustainability alignment with Idaho initiatives. Its differentiators include full-service design-to-delivery capabilities, eco-friendly material options, equipment automation expertise, and supply-chain streamlining through inventory management.

about:
ESCO Manufacturing is headquartered in Watertown, South Dakota. The company was founded in 1965 and has operated as a wholesale sign manufacturer for over half a century.

The company produces custom signs and channel letters, offering full-service manufacturing from design assistance through final production. Its capabilities include channel letter fabrication, custom cabinet production, face manufacturing, and church, school, and municipal signage. ESCO operates two dedicated facilities in South Dakota staffed by tenured professionals with decades of combined industry experience.

ESCO serves sign shops, electric sign companies, and municipal clients across the Midwest and beyond. Customer testimonials reference businesses such as JH Signs, All State Signs, Sandmann Signs & Electric, Indigo Signworks, AP Design, Total Motors, and Affordable Signs, indicating a wholesale customer base that relies on ESCO for channel letters, cabinets, and custom signage projects.

It emphasizes craftsmanship, dependable service, a customer-first approach, and the deep experience of its long-standing team as key differentiators.

name: Everbrite Electronics Inc
old_description: Providing Innovative Visual Identification Solutions Since 1927
about:
Everbrite Electronics Inc, headquartered in Greenfield, Wisconsin, has operated since 1927 as a woman-owned and minority-owned business. The company began as a visual identification firm and grew into one of the largest full-service signage and LED lighting providers in the United States.

Everbrite designs, manufactures, and installs a range of branding solutions including outdoor signage, indoor signs and displays, menu systems, architectural and drive-thru elements, electronic displays, scoreboards, and LED lighting. The company operates five sales and manufacturing facilities across the United States, offering multi-plant manufacturing capabilities and high-volume production capacity. A network of over 200 preferred installers provides nationwide installation and service, supported by site surveys, code research, permit procurement, and branding guideline development.

The company serves brands and retailers worldwide, delivering visual identification and lighting programs for national accounts. Its account management teams handle projects from inception through completion, managing Tier I and Tier II supplier diversity programs.

Everbrite differentiates itself through design and engineering excellence, state-of-the-art manufacturing, multi-plant capabilities, high-volume capacity, experienced account management, nationwide installation, and consistent financial stability. As a certified Women's Business Enterprise since 2002, it qualifies as a minority-owned supplier for corporate diversity programs.

name: Evolution Furniture
old_description: Evolution Furniture specializes in creating unique, custom-built furnishings for both commercial businesses and residential homes. Our team's experience and creativity enable us to tackle even the most challenging projects, and we manage every aspect, from the initial concept to the final delivery.
about:
Evolution Furniture operates from Naperville, Illinois, serving the Chicago metropolitan area with custom furniture fabrication, restoration, and design services. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure on its website.

The shop provides end-to-end custom furniture services: fabrication, restoration, upholstery, custom painting, and repair. A five-step process—Define, Discover, Design, Develop, Deliver—guides projects from initial conversation through 3D renderings, material selection, and final handcrafted production. The team manages sourcing, production, delivery, assembly, and placement for orders ranging from single pieces to large commercial installations.

Clients include commercial businesses, residential homeowners, and interior designers. Notable projects comprise the Uber Headquarters, Chicago Bears Halas Hall, Mondelez International offices, and the 1326 S Michigan development. The firm partners with the American Society of Interior Designers (ASID) and services suburbs such as Glencoe, Barrington, Winnetka, and Oak Brook.

Evolution Furniture emphasizes hands-on project management and on-time, on-budget delivery. Its differentiators include a collaborative design approach that incorporates architecture and fashion inspiration, skilled craftsmen executing detailed technical drawings, and a single-source responsibility for design, fabrication, and installation.

name: Evolution St. Louis
old_description: Evolution St. Louis - the premier high-tech knitting facility using cutting-edge 3D and complete garment seamless knitting technology - is creating the manufacturing facility and supply chain of the future. We revitalize the knit industry, allow American brands and retailers to keep pace with emerging trends, and make St. Louis the industry sector for advanced knitting and manufacturing.
about:
Evolution St. Louis operates a high-tech knitting facility in St. Louis, Missouri. The company builds on the city’s deep fashion-industry heritage to create what it calls the apparel manufacturing and supply chain facility of the future, focusing on advanced flat-bed knitting technology and the creation of new U.S. manufacturing jobs.

The facility runs STOLL ADF and CMS knit and wear® machines capable of 3D and complete-garment seamless knitting. It produces fully fashioned knits, sweaters knit to shape, footwear, smart textiles, and technical textiles, achieving complex geometries with minimal waste. Services include product engineering, prototyping, material sourcing and development, technology integration, IP protection, and testing, with small-batch runs enabled by short setup times. Linking, sewing, finishing, labeling, barcoding, and hangtag application are also offered in-house.

The company serves brands and retailers across apparel, footwear, accessories, technical and smart textiles, automotive, aerospace, home and furniture, lifestyle, sports, health and wellness, medical technology, and public-safety sectors such as medical, police, fire, and transit.

Evolution St. Louis was started to revitalize the domestic knit industry, allowing American brands to keep pace with emerging trends and positioning St. Louis as a hub for advanced knitting and manufacturing.

name: Evotronics Inc
old_description: We are the trusted Provider of printed circuit board (PCB) contract manufacturing services in the Minneapolis / St. Paul area
about:
Evotronics Inc is a family-owned PCB contract manufacturing company based in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Founded in 1995 by Tam Tran, the business is now led by co-owners Anh Tran and Ken Nguyen. The company began as a provider of design, manufacture, test, distribution, and repair services for electronic assemblies serving original equipment manufacturers.

The shop offers a full range of electronics assembly services, including through-hole and surface-mount assembly, custom cable assembly, electro-mechanical assembly, and final box-build with labeling and serialization. Capabilities extend to engineering support, first-article test runs, rework, and conformal coating application. The facility is climate-controlled and monitored by a surveillance system, and the company states it handles both small prototype runs and higher-volume production.

Evotronics serves OEMs across retail, consumer, industrial, medical, and defense/aerospace sectors. Customers rely on the company for prototyping, design-for-manufacturing feedback, and BOM alternative component sourcing.

The company emphasizes a no-stencil solder paste process for rapid prototyping, automated axial insertion for ammo-pack and cut-tape components, and an in-house flood box for in-line washing. Its quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015, with UL and FDA registrations, and it maintains an ESD-safe environment audited by a third party.
